name: 02116 · Boston, MA
findings: ZIP 02116 (Boston) has 409 nonprofit organizations. 138 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 127 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02116 (Boston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
